summary: Iteration 24 UI-focused verification. All 6 UI test cases PASS and iter22 backend regression suite (14/14) PASS. Verified: (1) Advanced fields section in EditContestDialog with all required data-testids; short_description + free_postal_entry_available persist end-to-end via admin edit UI. (2) engine_type dropdown offers 3 options {leaderboard, random_draw, instant_win}; all three persist via admin API. (3) /free-entry postal address, 5-bullet required list, and /legal/postal-entry link render correctly from /api/public/company. (4) Updating postal_address_line1 to 'PO Box 999' via PUT /api/admin/company is reflected on hard-reload of /free-entry; restored to '118 Windsor Road' after test. (5) /results/test-skill-leaderboard-contest-a0e33a renders winners-reveal-page hero with £500 prize pool, 0 entries, 1 winner; winners-empty and winners-tiebreak (4 rules) shown. (6) /competition/:slug shows see-results-link -> /results/:slug. Contest short_description + free_postal_entry_available restored to null/false after test.
critical_code_review_comments: EditContestDialog.jsx is ~485 lines with a very large save() payload block. Consider splitting the Advanced fields section into a sub-component to keep the parent under 400 lines and to make the 30+ fields easier to maintain.

WinnersReveal.jsx currently fetches /contests/:slug then /contests/:contest_id/leaderboard sequentially — two round trips. A single /contests/:slug/results-summary endpoint would remove one round trip and reduce flicker on the reveal page.
FreeEntry.jsx swallows all errors from /public/company silently (catch(()=>setC(null))). At minimum, add a Sentry-style console.warn so ops can detect if the company endpoint 500s in production.

Winners Reveal share text uses navigator.clipboard.writeText which throws in insecure contexts — the catch handler shows 'Copy failed' but no fallback (execCommand) is provided. Low priority since the deployed URL is HTTPS.
